# anthropic_api_key (Resource)

Manages the lifecycle (`name` and `status`) of an existing Claude Console API key (`/v1/organizations/api_keys/{api_key_id}`). Because the Anthropic Admin API never creates or returns plaintext key secrets, `Create` adopts an existing API key by `id` and reconciles its `name` and `status`. Destroying this resource deactivates the key (`status = "inactive"`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the API key (`apikey_...`).
- `name` (String) Display name of the API key.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the API key (`active`, `inactive`, `archived`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) ID of the user or service account that created the API key.
- `partial_key_hint` (String) Partially redacted hint of the API key (e.g. `sk-ant-api03-R2D...igAA`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`api_key`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID the API key belongs to, or `null` for the default workspace.
